In dimension three with distinct λ the barycentric inverse takes the respective values 1,0,0 at the vertices; the affine determinant has magnitude Δ and the Dirichlet normalization is 1/(2π). The positive-quadrant change of variables is bijective with absolute Jacobian 4h/s³, proving the repaired density, normalization and direction recovery up to signs.
